Ltd., A Company incorporated under The Companies Act, 1956 Having its registered office at: No.14, 1st Cross, Brunton Road Bangalore - 560 025 Represented by its Director Mr.Venkat Rajendran ...Petitioner (By Smt.Jayna Kothari, Adv.,) And 1. The Commissioner Bruhat Bangalore Mahanagar Palike Corporation Circle Bangalore - 560 002 2. The Health Officer, (Btm) Zonal Office Bruhat Bangalore Mahanagar Palike 16th Main Road, Opposite Chamundeshwari Temple Btm 2nd State, Bangalore - 560 076 3.
texts.facts: Learned counsel for Respondent Nos.1 and 2 has produced the statement of objections along with certain documents with photographs on the date of earlier survey and the inspection carried out by the Health Officer of the BBMP, on the complaint of non-maintenance of hygienic conditions in the central kitchen of the petitioner- company which runs a chain of restaurant in Bengaluru. as per Schedule XI under Section 431 of the Karnataka Municipal Corporations Act, 1976 is `500/- for each of such offence and therefore for the alleged offence the maximum penalty would be `1,000/-. In view of the inspection carried out by the Health Inspector on 22.10.2016, learned counsel for respondent-BBMP, has submitted that the impugned order passed by the respondent-BBMP was justified. In the meanwhile, the petitioner- company may be allowed to run its business in the aforesaid Central kitchen and no coercive process be taken against the petitioner-company without the leave of this Court. However, the petitioner- company is also directed to maintain all hygiene and suitable cleanliness in and around the area where it is operating.
